note: REFUTED. sub-is-add 4/64; less-is-lesseq 0/64 with a live probe. harness/ deliberately NOT a dep: it only APPLIES the mutation, and the failure mode a bad edit would cause (mutation never reaches the binary) is exactly what the mutant-is-live probe control catches.

controls.name: mutant-is-live
controls.must_fire_because: 0/64 is what a dead mutant, a failed rebuild or a missed anchor also produce
controls.can_fail_because: an inert or unbuilt mutation returns an identical probe; the run is then reported VOID instead of as a detection rate
controls.null_must_contain: probe output differs before vs after for every mutation

controls.name: noise-floor-measured
controls.must_fire_because: a program whose result varies run-to-run scores as a detector by chance
controls.can_fail_because: if many programs were nondeterministic the floor would swamp the signal and no rate would be reportable
controls.null_must_contain: programs varying across 4 identical unmutated sweeps

falsifier: the corpus detects these mutations broadly -- a wrong evaluator changes many agreement keys
